title: top-up: egress sidecar lifecycle and start-up egress self-check
definition: Egress sidecar helper that creates the internal network, starts the CONNECT proxy and connects it from a launch plan's fixed argv, using argument-vector runtime calls under explicit timeouts and refusing a plan that declares enforcement without every network and proxy key; plus the egress self-check (Issue #4048) and its command, which read the launch plan's enforcement and runtime identity variables, dial bounded TCP probes to fixed targets, and exit with a fixed status when the policy is not proved. No shell interpolation, no GitHub or model writes.
